changes: The week's substance is Anthropic's Frontier Red Team report on GLM-5.3 (open-weight exploit development plus cheap safeguard removal), and the first in-the-wild exploitation of an AI-discovered vulnerability — CVE-2026-61500 in Rejetto HFS, found with Claude Mythos and attacked from a China-hosted IP within ~24 hours of disclosure. Secondary signals: Google suspended its OSS bug-bounty intake under AI-generated report spam, and Apple is tightening macOS Full Disk Access because of agent data access.
incident: AI-discovered Rejetto HFS flaw (CVE-2026-61500) exploited in the wild within ~24 hours
incident: Google halts Open Source Software VRP submissions amid AI-generated report flood
